title: Implement Request Body Parsing for JSON and URL-Encoded Data
description: This feature is crucial for handling JSON and URL-encoded request bodies, enabling yantraverse to support a wider range of API use cases and improve overall framework usability. It will provide automatic parsing of request bodies into JavaScript objects. This enhancement will simplify development and improve performance for users of the framework.
acceptance: The feature is accepted when request bodies are correctly parsed into JavaScript objects for both JSON and URL-encoded data, and error handling is properly implemented for invalid request bodies.
reason: Adding request body parsing will make yantraverse more competitive with other lightweight Node.js frameworks and improve the developer experience by reducing boilerplate code and increasing the ease of handling different types of request data.
